questions.answer: It was quite easy. I found it through prag-shared-flats.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: If you want to really get the full experience of the city you should definitely live off campus. The campus housing is far outside the city center

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Courses are all 5/4/3 ECTS points. So you need a lot of courses, and that makes it hard for courses to not overlap.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Just write to the teachers if you have any questions

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: My courses were picked to have minimum amount of overlapping courses. But you can get most of the courses you want if you ask the teacher

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Scheduling courses without overlapping can be challenging.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Level is mostly easier, but there is a lot of busy work. The assignments are easy, but there are a lot of them.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It feels like you take a step down to gymnasium again. It is a little weird to get used to.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Programming and data processing in Python	- Very easy
Introduction to Language Technologies - Very easy
Introduction to Computer Graphics
Introduction to Colour Science
Data Formats - DO NOT RECOMMEND
Software System Architectures
Programming of Web Applications

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
I would recommend Introduction to Computer Graphics. The teacher is really passionate about the course, which makes the lectures really interesting. 
I DO NOT recommend Data Formats. The teacher is super rude, and the amount of work for 5 ECTS is insane - also a hard exam.

What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Getting information about the courses. There is no single platform where all info arrives about your courses. So you have to check a lot of different website to figure out if you have any assignments. A lot of info gets lost because nothing is written down and published online. A lot of the time the teacher just says something important in one lecture, and if you are not there you will not receive this information. This is really frustrating.
